_note: The crab's underside: a crab turned on its back in the sun (from straight below the light is too dim to read), a tile lying beside its abdomen. The folded abdomen (the broad banded flap on the underside) was one tile, 200 mm, wide; with the crab now 90 mm across (R1.8) it is about 38 mm.
name: Crab from below
